errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: One account per person. Your partner joins later with an invitation.

pending.title: Check your email
pending.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to continue.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.body: It may have expired or already been used. Log in to ask for a new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

done.title: Password updated
done.body: You were logged out on every device. Log in with your new password.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.body: Reset links work once and for one hour.

noHousehold.title: You are not in a household yet
noHousehold.body: Ask the person who manages your household to invite you, then open the link from the email.

deleted.title: {name} is scheduled for deletion
deleted.body: Everything in it will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can restore it.
deleted.memberBody: Everything in it will be deleted on {date}. Only the owner can restore it before then.

invite.title: Join {household}
invite.from: {inviter} invited {email} to share their household on monkimoney.
invite.fromUnknown: {email} was invited to share a household on monkimoney.
invite.otherEmail: This invitation is for {email}. Log out, then log in with that account.
invite.full: This household already has all its members.

alreadyIn.title: You already have a household
alreadyIn.body: monkimoney supports one household per person for now, so this invitation cannot be used with your account.

invalid.title: This invitation does not exist
invalid.body: Check the link in the email, or ask for a new invitation.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for 7 days and only once. Ask for a new one.
